messages.subject: setting eval=FALSE globally
parts:
I want to avoid R to execute a whole script.

I try with  test_log.R:

knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval=FALSE)
x <- 1+2
x

The I run
spin("test_log.R")

but I do get the value of x in the resulting html

I know how to do it by chunks, but was this not the way of setting it globally?

Thanks
